# test-data-generator

Install: npm install @ferrow/test-data-generator
> Seeded deterministic fake data generator with schema-driven generation

Seeded deterministic fake-data generator with schema-driven generation. Same seed produces identical output every time — critical for reproducible test suites.

## API
- `TestDataGenerator`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/FerrowAI.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
